name: Killigan's Treasure
source:
Set in the land of Canavar, you play as a bull-like barbarian named Killigan Stoneworth, determined to follow an enchanted treasure map throughout the world. He meets several companions in his journey that join him in his quest for unimaginable riches, and who can become even more than companions along the way.

[From [url=https://eddio.itch.io/killigans-treasure]Itch.io[/url]]
